subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: After the branch is rebased and lint is rerun, should OpenClaw accept `announceLastRun` plus tool-free announce completion handoffs as the canonical session/security boundary for this recovery path?
rationale: The implementation appears correct, but it changes persisted restart recovery state and execution-tool exposure in a session-state and security-boundary path, so a maintainer should own the boundary decision before merge.

options.title: Accept after rebase and green lint
